title: Mixed Event — Time to RE:START! — Episode7 New Choices

meta.Event Outline: Eager to make MORE MORE JUMP! official, Airi and the others waste no time in searching for an agency to join, but...

rows.Line: Cafe

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sorry for the wait.
Here's your iced mocha.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you for coming!
Enjoy your drink!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Part-Time Staff Leader
rows.Line:
What's wrong, Hanasato?
You seem a little out of it today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I... I'm sorry! I was worrying about something last night and had a time hard falling asleep. Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Part-Time Staff Leader
rows.Line: Oh, really? It's a bit early, but why don't you go ahead and take your break now? That should help a little.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...!
I'll be back right after lunch!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No... Now I'm causing problems at work... I need to focus after my break is over!)

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line:
Hey, stop it!
Put that camera away...!

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Ugh! You better erase that video!

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line: Why? The viewers love little behind-the-scenes glimpses like this one.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It sounds like they're taking a video.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... A video...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I remember watching a lot of videos online when I was learning how to do different dances.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It was really convenient, and there were tons of different videos to choose from too...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Whenever I had a little time, I'd watch idols...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh my goodness! That's it! If MORE MORE JUMP! started uploading videos like the idols I saw in those videos...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I've never done anything like that before. I wonder how hard it would be to...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, we won't know unless we try!
That's the first step!
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Hello viewers!
I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Today, I'd like to introduce you to someone... Me! Ta-daaa!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Umm... I guess I already told you my name so... I'm a first-year high school student and a member of the animal caretaker committee!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One of my favorite hobbies is keeping a daily diary!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I usually write about what happened that day or what kind of practice I did after school...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, wait! This is a video...
I guess I can just show you...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Let's see... Here we go.
Is this in focus? I sure hope you can see this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I also love learning different idols' dance routines! Here, I'll do a quick demonstration for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let me just put the camera down and... Oh, this might be too low. All you can see is my feet, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Maybe I can find somewhere a bit higher... Oh, let me try over here... There, that should work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Gasp! Noooo!
The camera's gonna fall over!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sob... The camera wouldn't focus on my diary and I couldn't find a good spot to record a dance video.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You can't even see half of my face in most of video either.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Making a video is harder than I thought...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...?
What's the matter, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, actually...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. So you decided to try making a video?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. I can't become an idol if I just sit around and mope. I need to do whatever I can.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Uploading videos of us doing idol activities, huh?
That's certainly one way of doing things.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm impressed, Minori.
I think it's a wonderful idea.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-It's just an idea I had!
Besides, I couldn't really get it to work!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but even if something seems difficult on your own, it may become easier by working together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd like to give it a try.
Let's see what the others think as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay...!
Thanks, Shizuku!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Talent Insider
rows.Line: <I'm very sorry, but I just don't see that working out for us.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you for your time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Another dead end...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I thought maybe an agency just getting off the ground might be open to the idea, but I guess I was wrong.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm starting to think we may never find an agency that's willing to take us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I need to stay positive. It wouldn't be right to give up hope while the others are still trying so hard...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Who else might be willing to meet with us? I've already contacted so many people...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, this girl! She freelances as a celebrity...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I remember her talking about how much she loved her job despite how much work it was.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Freelancing...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wonder if we could be an independent idol group that isn't affiliated with a talent agency.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, it's not realistic. That person works solo too and has much more flexibility in terms of finding work...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's hard to think that we could do the same as a four-member idol group.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then... What on Earth are we going to do...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's from Airi...?
I wonder what's going on?
